gloss: to be overwhelmed; to be overpowered

definitions.gloss: to be overwhelmed; to be overpowered; to be awed
definitions.explanation: To feel completely dominated or overcome by something far greater in power, scale, or intensity. Can describe being impressed to the point of speechlessness, or being defeated by a stronger force.

examples.japanese: {景色|けしき}の{美|うつく}しさに{圧倒|あっとう}された。
examples.english: I was overwhelmed by the beauty of the scenery.

examples.japanese: {相手|あいて}チームの{実力|じつりょく}に{圧倒|あっとう}されてしまった。
examples.english: We were overpowered by the opposing team's ability.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めてオーケストラの{生|なま}{演奏|えんそう}を{聴|き}いて、その{迫力|はくりょく}に{圧倒|あっとう}された。
examples.english: When I heard a live orchestra performance for the first time, I was overwhelmed by its power.

notes:
USAGE:
{圧倒|あっとう}される is the passive form of {圧倒|あっとう}する. It is far more commonly used than the active form in everyday speech. The particle に marks what overwhelms the speaker.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {迫力|はくりょく}に{圧倒|あっとう}される (to be overwhelmed by the intensity)
- {数|かず}に{圧倒|あっとう}される (to be overwhelmed by sheer numbers)
- {圧倒|あっとう}される{思|おも}い (an overwhelming feeling)
- {圧倒|あっとう}されて{言葉|ことば}を{失|うしな}う (to be speechless with awe)

RELATED WORDS:
- {圧倒的|あっとうてき}: overwhelming (adjective)
- {圧倒|あっとう}する: to overwhelm (active)
